C1182.title: National Notification Center Warns of Multiple Supply Chain Poisoning Attacks
C1182.summary: The National Cybersecurity Notification Center detected a recent surge in supply chain poisoning attacks targeting the API development tool Apifox, the Python library LiteLLM, and the JavaScript library Axios.
